title: Linguistic Bias Mitigation for Spoofing Detection via Gradient Reversal and A Variational Information Bottleneck
abstract: arXiv:2606.31411v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Rapid advancements in generative speech technology have compromised the reliability of voice biometrics. While current spoofing detectors excel when assessed under in-domain conditions, generalisation to out-of-domain settings is often poor. We show that this can be due to linguistic bias. A reliance on linguistic cues observed in training data can then compromise robustness to cross-data. We propose a linguistic-invariant spoofing detection framework utilizing teacher-student adversarial learning. The linguistic-aware teacher model, pre-trained on linguistic content of an external dataset, guides the student detector via gradient reversal to minimize the linguistic information. To prevent the inadvertent removal of non-linguistic cues, we incorporate a Variational Information Bottleneck to enable suppression of principal cues. translated_title: 基于梯度反转与变分信息瓶颈的语音欺骗检测语言偏差消除方法
translated_abstract: 生成式语音技术的快速发展已经损害了语音生物特征识别的可靠性。虽然当前的欺骗检测器在域内条件下评估时表现出色，但对域外设置的泛化能力通常较差。我们表明这可能是由语言偏差造成的。对训练数据中观察到的语言线索的依赖会损害跨数据场景下的鲁棒性。我们提出了一种利用师生对抗学习的语言不变欺骗检测框架。在外部数据集的语言内容上预训练的语言感知教师模型，通过梯度反转引导学生检测器最小化语言信息。为防止非语言线索被意外移除，我们引入了变分信息瓶颈来实现对主要线索的抑制。在九个DF Arena数据集上，与现有方法相比，我们的方法在等错误率（EER）方面实现了高达36.2%的相对降低。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于师生对抗学习与变分信息瓶颈的语言不变语音欺骗检测框架，通过梯度反转消除语言偏差，在九个DF Arena数据集上实现了最高36.2%的等错误率相对降低。
